Not sick as in awesome, sick as in I am a big ball of snot right now and people are going to really hate me on the plane.  I just need it to make it on our plane in LA take a NyQuil, and then pass out for 10 hours.  I didn't really need to drink that bottle wine during our annual " lets drink way too much with our friends the night before we jump on a plane " event.

 Getting here was interesting and I'm sure it's a precursor to what we're going to experience on the flight. Andy was in a sarcastic sassy mood, and during his sassiness missed the turn for the bridge. Good thing we left hella early (they were giving me shit for it) because we had a slight detour.  It's like after living here in his entire life he doesn't know where it traffic is really like. Got to the airport without any problems plane delay. All good. Yes I like to get to the airport early, I'm turning into my mother.
